item.title: Trump calls leaders to isolate Iran. And, SCOTUS backs Trump for now on mail-in voting

item.title: At least 25% of former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had CTE, study finds
item.description: Playing football has long been linked to the brain disease known as CTE, but how prevalent it is is still unknown. A new study of former NFL players who died recently found that at least 25% had CTE.

item.title: Kids with brain injuries thrive at this camp. But federal research funding is in flux
item.description: A Pennsylvania summer camp helps children who have survived brain injuries. But the future of federal funding for brain injury research, as well as grants to states to help such patients, is in limbo.
